Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.window

Schnittstelle Window

Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
SwingWindow
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
InternalFrameAdapter, WindowAdapter
public interface Window

Definition of an interface for describing windows in a platform independent way.

This interface is an abstraction of a typical window. It defines methods for querying and setting window related properties. For each supported GUI library (or platform) there will be an implementation that hides the specifics of window objects of that library. So application code can simply manipulate these objects through the methods provided here.

    • open

      void open()
      Opens the window. This method must be called to make the window visible for the first time.

    • close

      boolean close(boolean force)
      Closes this window. This should cause all resources obtained by the window to be freed. After invocation, the window instance should not be used any longer. The force parameter determines whether the window's WindowClosingStrategy is to be invoked: if set to false, the WindowClosingStrategy is queried, and the window is only closed if permitted. Otherwise, the window is always closed. The return value indicates the success of the operation. A value of false means that the window could not be closed because the WindowClosingStrategy prohibited this operation.
      Parameter:
      force - a flag whether the window is to be closed unconditionally
      Gibt zurück:
      a flag whether this operation was successful

    • getWindowController

      Object getWindowController()
      Returns the controller object for this window. The window's controller is a simple POJO provided by the application that can react on window or component events, thus acting as a typical controller.
      Gibt zurück:
      the window's controller (can be null if no controller was specified when the window was created)

      l - the mouse listener to be added
